item.title: What to Know About Elections in West Bengal and Other Indian States
item.description: Vote counting starts on Monday after over 154 million people participated in elections for state legislatures last month. The contests can tilt the balance of power for the whole country.

item.title: Oil Tanker Hijacking Stokes Fear of Links Between Houthi Rebels and Somali Pirates
item.description: The location and timing of the attack fueled concerns about collaboration between Somali pirates and the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen under the cover of Mideast turmoil.

item.title: ‘Wartime Relic’ Explodes Under Campfire in Austria, Injuring Five Children
item.description: The children, aged 10 to 14, were taken to a hospital for treatment after the explosion in Upper Austria, the police said.
